in_marathi.name: Dasrath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dasrath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dasrath is a Sanskrit name that means 'ten chariots'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'das', meaning 'ten', and 'rath', meaning 'chariot'. In Hindu mythology, Dasrath was the name of King Rama's father, who ruled Ayodhya.
